title: tussl-chemistry emitted command, schema 1.x
description: The object `tchem --emit <pipeline> --format json` prints: a command for one pipeline, built from the run's verdict. Not a report (see report.v1.json); versioned on its own. See docs/emit.md.

layout.description: The matched layout the command is for.

validation.description: The layout's held-out record, as the text report words it.

argv.description: The program and its arguments. An item ${NAME} is a placeholder: replace it with a value for that entry of placeholders. No other item is shell syntax.

shell.description: The same command as a POSIX shell script; placeholders read from the environment and stop with their meaning when unset.
